name: dev.3dassets/catalogue
title: 3DAssets.dev
description: Search and download free CC0 GLB models and game packs, and submit new ones on a user behalf.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Optional. "Bearer <api key>" from https://3dassets.dev/account, needed only to submit models on the user behalf; search and download work without it.

environmentVariables.name: THREEDASSETS_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional. The user API key from https://3dassets.dev/account, needed only to submit models on the user behalf.
